# Test: apx optable render with a gRPC API: the operations come from a Buf
# image (the JSON form of 'buf build -o ledger.json'), and the descriptor set
# goes into its own ConfigMap (native Go, no external tools)

# The Buf image marks timestamp.proto and ops.proto as imports: only the five
# Ledger methods are operations
exec apx optable render --binding binding.yaml --spec proto/acme/ledger/v1=ledger.json --out out --route-table
stdout 'proto/acme/ledger/v1 v1.0.0 \(internal\): 5 operations: read=1 list=1 write=3 custom=0 -> optable-78c049294f, optable-78c049294f-descriptors'
stdout 'route ledger/ledger: 5 operations, default API proto/acme/ledger/v1'
stdout 'wrote 3 file\(s\) to out: optable-78c049294f.yaml, optable-78c049294f-descriptors.yaml, route-table.json'
grep '"path": "/acme.ledger.v1.Ledger/GetEntry"' out/optable-78c049294f.yaml
grep '"operationId": "Ledger_ListEntries"' out/optable-78c049294f.yaml
grep '"method": "POST"' out/optable-78c049294f.yaml
grep '"descriptor": \{' out/optable-78c049294f.yaml
grep '"configMap": "optable-78c049294f-descriptors"' out/optable-78c049294f.yaml
grep '"key": "descriptors.binpb.gz"' out/optable-78c049294f.yaml
grep '"digest": "sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}"' out/optable-78c049294f.yaml
! grep 'acme.ops.v1' out/optable-78c049294f.yaml

grep '^kind: ConfigMap$' out/optable-78c049294f-descriptors.yaml
grep '^  name: optable-78c049294f-descriptors$' out/optable-78c049294f-descriptors.yaml
grep '^    apx.infoblox.com/descriptor-set: "true"$' out/optable-78c049294f-descriptors.yaml
grep '^    apx.infoblox.com/api: proto/acme/ledger/v1$' out/optable-78c049294f-descriptors.yaml
grep '^    apx.infoblox.com/api-version: v1.0.0$' out/optable-78c049294f-descriptors.yaml
grep '^    apx.infoblox.com/descriptor-digest: sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' out/optable-78c049294f-descriptors.yaml
grep '^binaryData:$' out/optable-78c049294f-descriptors.yaml
grep '^  descriptors.binpb.gz: ' out/optable-78c049294f-descriptors.yaml

grep '"path": "/acme.ledger.v1.Ledger/SyncEntries"' out/route-table.json
grep '"operation": "Ledger_UploadEntries"' out/route-table.json
grep '"streaming": true' out/route-table.json
! grep 'acme.ops.v1' out/route-table.json

# A second render gives the same bytes
exec apx optable render --binding binding.yaml --spec proto/acme/ledger/v1=ledger.json --out again --route-table
cmp again/optable-78c049294f.yaml out/optable-78c049294f.yaml
cmp again/optable-78c049294f-descriptors.yaml out/optable-78c049294f-descriptors.yaml

# The JSON summary names the descriptor ConfigMap
exec apx optable render --binding binding.yaml --spec proto/acme/ledger/v1=ledger.json --out json --format json
stdout '"descriptor": "optable-78c049294f-descriptors"'
stdout '"configMap": "optable-78c049294f"'
stdout '"optable-78c049294f-descriptors.yaml"'

# A gRPC API needs --spec: --specs-dir does not compile .proto files
! exec apx optable render --binding binding.yaml --specs-dir apis --out none
stderr 'API proto/acme/ledger/v1: a gRPC API needs --spec proto/acme/ledger/v1=<descriptor set>'
! exists none

# A set without an import of its files is an error
! exec apx optable render --binding binding.yaml --spec proto/acme/ledger/v1=incomplete.json --out none
stderr 'not complete'
! exists none

# An externalPrefix other than / on a gRPC API is an error
! exec apx optable render --binding prefixed.yaml --spec proto/acme/ledger/v1=ledger.json --out none
stderr 'externalPrefix "/api": a gRPC path has no prefix'
! exists none

-- binding.yaml --
apiVersion: appkit.infoblox.dev/v1alpha1
kind: AppContract
metadata:
  name: ledger
  namespace: ledger
spec:
  provides:
    apis:
      - name: ledger
        ref: apx://proto/acme/ledger/v1@v1.0.0
        serviceName: ledger
        routes:
          targetRefs:
            - {group: networking.k8s.io, kind: Ingress, name: ledger}
-- prefixed.yaml --
apiVersion: appkit.infoblox.dev/v1alpha1
kind: AppContract
metadata:
  name: ledger
  namespace: ledger
spec:
  provides:
    apis:
      - name: ledger
        ref: apx://proto/acme/ledger/v1@v1.0.0
        serviceName: ledger
        routes:
          externalPrefix: /api
          targetRefs:
            - {group: networking.k8s.io, kind: Ingress, name: ledger}
-- apis/proto/acme/ledger/v1/ledger.proto --
syntax = "proto3";
package acme.ledger.v1;
